title: 第5章 老天爷赏饭吃第6章 修习天地万法如掌上观纹
slug: 人在镇魔司红词加身只杀不渡
lines: 林辰一脸冰寒，大步走来，目光之中煞气翻涌。
他痛恨陆渊。
不给他直升名额也就罢了，居然趁他不备将他打成重伤，差点耽误了他参加新血选拔。
还好林嫚儿找上了考官周通，周通看他资质上佳，送了一份疗伤灵药。
也因此，他因祸得福，伤势痊愈之后修为也突破到了凡境六层。
人群中，众多新人脸色一变，纷纷将目光看了过来。
“陆渊？他就是那个习武五年的凡境二层？”
“这种资质也能进镇魔司？”
“没听说吗？人家是有名额的。”
进入镇魔司以来，陆渊并没有过多的走动。
众多新人之所以能知晓他的底细，离不开林辰在暗地里推波助澜。
当然了，这一切也离不开周通的授意。
在他看来，让一个资质奇差的人进入镇魔司，这本身就是对斩妖除魔的玷污。
林辰没有多说，凡境六层的修为彻底爆发，探手成爪，直取陆渊咽喉。
“陆渊，今天我要你血债血......”
话还没说完。
砰！
陆渊出手，一拳砸出，一记重击逆势而上，直接轰在了林辰的胸口。
胸骨凹陷，骨骼断裂的声音不断响起。
噗！
林辰一口鲜血喷出，还没反应过来，就以比来时更快的速度倒飞出去，重重跌在了锁妖井旁。
他倒在血泊中，口鼻之中不断溢出鲜血。
陆渊侧目看去，眼神漠然。
林辰浑身一颤，那双布满血丝的眼中满是恐惧，仿佛看到了什么凶神恶煞一般。
顾不得身上的疼痛，他连滚带爬地向后退去。
难以言喻的情绪充斥在他心中。
他怎么也想不明白，凡境六层的他怎么会挡不住陆渊随手一拳？
他连完整的招式都没用出，就被打成了重伤。
陆渊收回目光，没再搭理这种炮灰，迈步走向锁妖井。
周围众人如梦初醒，脸色复杂，不敢再有丝毫轻视，下意识向两边让开一条走道。
林辰是凡境六层，居然被一拳打成重伤。
这份修为......
凡境七层？还是八层？
这一刻，全场窒息。
就在这时，锁妖井旁的石碑上，一个名字突然出现。
陆渊，一息，两只妖魔。
很快，数字又跳动了一下。
三息，五只妖魔。
content_en:
Lin Chen strode over with a cold expression on his face, his eyes filled with evil energy.
He hated Lu Yuan.
It was enough not to give him a spot for direct promotion, but he was seriously injured when he was not prepared, which almost delayed his participation in the selection of new blood.
Fortunately, Lin Man'er found the examiner Zhou Tong. Seeing that he had excellent qualifications, Zhou Tong gave him a healing elixir.
Because of this, he was a blessing in disguise. After recovering from his injuries, his cultivation level also broke through to the sixth level of the mortal realm.
In the crowd, many newcomers' expressions changed and they all looked over.
"Lu Yuan? Is he the second-level mortal who has practiced martial arts for five years?"
"Can you enter the Demon-Suppressing Division with this kind of qualification?"
"Haven't you heard? There are quotas."
Since entering the Demon Suppression Division, Lu Yuan has not moved around much.
The reason why so many newcomers knew his details was because Lin Chen secretly contributed to the situation.
Of course, all this is inseparable from Zhou Tong's instruction.
In his opinion, allowing a person with extremely poor qualifications to enter the Demon Suppression Department is a stain on the Demon Slayer.
Lin Chen didn't say much, and his cultivation level at the sixth level of the mortal realm completely exploded, his hands turned into claws, and he went straight for Lu Yuan's throat.
"Lu Yuan, today I want your blood..."
The words are not finished yet.
Bang!
Lu Yuan took action, punched out, and hit Lin Chen directly in the chest with a heavy blow.
Click, click...
The sternum was sunken, and the sound of broken bones continued to sound.
puff!
Lin Chen spurted out a mouthful of blood, and before he could react, he flew backwards at a faster speed than when he came in, and fell heavily next to the Demon Locking Well.
He fell in a pool of blood, and blood continued to flow from his mouth and nose.
Lu Yuan looked sideways, his eyes indifferent.
Lin Chen trembled all over, and his bloodshot eyes were full of fear, as if he had seen something sinister.
Ignoring the pain in his body, he rolled back and crawled back.
Unspeakable emotions filled his heart.
He couldn't understand why he, at the sixth level of the mortal realm, couldn't block Lu Yuan's casual punch?
He didn't even use the complete move before he was seriously injured.
Lu Yuan withdrew his gaze, ignored this cannon fodder, and walked towards the Demon Locking Well.
The people around him seemed to have just woken up from a dream, with complicated expressions on their faces. They did not dare to show any contempt anymore, and subconsciously moved to both sides to open a aisle.
Lin Chen was at the sixth level of the mortal realm and was seriously injured by a punch.
This cultivation...
Seventh level of mortal realm? Or the eighth floor?
At this moment, the whole audience was suffocated.
At this moment, a name suddenly appeared on the stone tablet next to the Suoyao Well.
Lu Yuan, one breath, two demons.
Soon, the number jumped again.
Three breaths, five demons.
